title_sq: APARTAMENT 1+1 PER SHITJE NE KOMPLEKSIN MAGNET!

title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MAGNET COMPLEX!
description_en: We offer for sale a 1+1 apartment in the Magnet Complex (Contact) The apartment is located on the 0th floor of a new building built in 2022 inside the complex. It is organized in: - Entrance corridor - Bedroom - Toilet - Balcony The apartment is completely furnished in a contemporary way. Quite suitable for investment or AiR BnB activity but also for personal residence. The property has regular mortgage documentation and can be sold with credit. For more information, contact me.
